verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 4.76
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 4.76

verses.pali: 8. Apaṇṇakavagga
verses.english: 8.  Sure Bet

verses.pali: Kusinārasutta
verses.english: At Kusinārā

verses.pali: Ekaṁ samayaṁ bhagavā kusinārāyaṁ viharati upavattane mallānaṁ sālavane antarena yamakasālānaṁ parinibbānasamaye.
verses.english: At one time the Buddha was staying between a pair of sal trees in the sal forest of the Mallas at Upavattana near Kusinārā at the time of his full extinguishment.

verses.pali: Tatra kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi:
verses.english: There the Buddha addressed the mendicants,

verses.pali: “bhikkhavo”ti.
verses.english: “Mendicants!”

verses.pali: “Bhadante”ti te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṁ.
verses.english: “Venerable sir,” they replied.

verses.pali: Bhagavā etadavoca:
verses.english: The Buddha said this:

verses.pali: “Siyā kho pana, bhikkhave, ekabhikkhussapi kaṅkhā vā vimati vā buddhe vā dhamme vā saṅghe vā magge vā paṭipadāya vā, pucchatha, bhikkhave, mā pacchā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha:
verses.english: “Perhaps even a single mendicant has doubt or uncertainty regarding the Buddha, the teaching, the Saṅgha, the path, or the practice. So ask, mendicants! Don’t regret it later, thinking:

verses.pali: ‘sammukhībhūto no satthā ahosi, nāsakkhimha bhagavantaṁ sammukhā paṭipucchitun’”ti.
verses.english: ‘We were in the Teacher’s presence and we weren’t able to ask the Buddha a question.’”

verses.pali: Evaṁ vutte, te bhikkhū tuṇhī ahesuṁ.
verses.english: When this was said, the mendicants kept silent.

verses.pali: Dutiyampi kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi:
verses.english: For a second time the Buddha addressed the mendicants: …

verses.pali: “siyā kho pana, bhikkhave, ekabhikkhussapi kaṅkhā vā vimati vā buddhe vā dhamme vā saṅghe vā magge vā paṭipadāya vā, pucchatha, bhikkhave, mā pacchā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha:
‘sammukhībhūto no satthā ahosi, nāsakkhimha bhagavantaṁ sammukhā paṭipucchitun’”ti.
Dutiyampi kho te bhikkhū tuṇhī ahesuṁ.
verses.english: For a second time, the mendicants kept silent.

verses.pali: Tatiyampi kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi:
verses.english: For a third time the Buddha addressed the mendicants: …

verses.pali: “siyā kho pana, bhikkhave, ekabhikkhussapi kaṅkhā vā vimati vā buddhe vā dhamme vā saṅghe vā magge vā paṭipadāya vā, pucchatha, bhikkhave, mā pacchā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha:
‘sammukhībhūto no satthā ahosi, nāsakkhimha bhagavantaṁ sammukhā paṭipucchitun’”ti.
Tatiyampi kho te bhikkhū tuṇhī ahesuṁ.
verses.english: For a third time, the mendicants kept silent.

verses.pali: Atha kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi:
verses.english: Then the Buddha said to the mendicants:

verses.pali: “siyā kho pana, bhikkhave, satthugāravenapi na puccheyyātha, sahāyakopi, bhikkhave, sahāyakassa ārocetū”ti.
verses.english: “Mendicants, perhaps you don’t ask out of respect for the Teacher. So let a friend tell a friend.”

verses.pali: Evaṁ vutte, te bhikkhū tuṇhī ahesuṁ.
verses.english: When this was said, the mendicants kept silent.

verses.pali: Atha kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Then Venerable Ānanda said to the Buddha:

verses.pali: “acchariyaṁ, bhante, abbhutaṁ, bhante.
verses.english: “It’s incredible, sir, it’s amazing!

verses.pali: Evaṁ pasanno ahaṁ, bhante. Natthi imasmiṁ bhikkhusaṅghe ekabhikkhussapi kaṅkhā vā vimati vā buddhe vā dhamme vā saṅghe vā magge vā paṭipadāya vā”ti.
verses.english: I am quite confident that there’s not even a single mendicant in this Saṅgha who has doubt or uncertainty regarding the Buddha, the teaching, the Saṅgha, the path, or the practice.”

verses.pali: “Pasādā kho tvaṁ, ānanda, vadesi. Ñāṇameva hettha, ānanda, tathāgatassa: ‘natthi imasmiṁ bhikkhusaṅghe ekabhikkhussapi kaṅkhā vā vimati vā buddhe vā dhamme vā saṅghe vā magge vā paṭipadāya vā’.
verses.english: “Ānanda, you speak from faith. But the Realized One knows that there’s not even a single mendicant in this Saṅgha who has doubt or uncertainty regarding the Buddha, the teaching, the Saṅgha, the path, or the practice.

verses.pali: Imesañhi, ānanda, pañcannaṁ bhikkhusatānaṁ yo pacchimako bhikkhu so sotāpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo”ti.
verses.english: Even the last of these five hundred mendicants is a stream-enterer, not liable to be reborn in the underworld, assured, destined for awakening.”

verses.pali: Chaṭṭhaṁ.
